harness_contract.intent: C13 negative regression: show that runtime_observation_semantics, which means one invocation observed all channels, is never composed from channel-specific acceptance reports or recheck reports. Build one zero-output native bundle, run the three single-channel accepts plus observations-recheck and observations-accept, then fold the real reports with recovery-eval. Use the native-stdout-accept report as the record because its checks_not_performed declares exit-status, stderr and runtime semantics unperformed and its expected_build_id scopes sibling reports to the same bundle.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/native_observations_recovery/src/main.mm (the bounded native profile atom main() -> i64 requires: true).
Step 1 builds a real mumei.native-bundle/v1, verifies exit status 0 and the SHA-256 of empty stdout and stderr are pinned in link_build, and records sha256(native-bundle.json) as the build ID.

Steps 2–6 run native-exit-status-accept, native-stdout-accept, native-stderr-accept, native-observations-recheck and native-observations-accept using the same build ID; assert their accepted/reproduced outcomes.

The native-stdout-accept report is the record for all folds: its checks_not_performed contains os_exit_status_observation, os_stderr_observation and runtime_observation_semantics, while its expected_build_id binds it to sibling reports for the same bundle.
Recovery A uses exit-status and stderr accept reports as evidence: both channel checks recover, while runtime_observation_semantics is no_evidence.
Recovery B uses only the reproduced observations-recheck report: none of the record's runtime checks recover because recheck reports are not performers.
Recovery C uses the accepted observations-accept report: exit status, stderr and runtime_observation_semantics recover from the same accepted one-invocation observation.

name: C13 Native Observations Recovery Composition Regression
description: C13 negative regression: runtime_observation_semantics is a one-invocation claim and must never be composed from three channel acceptance reports or a recheck. Folds real route reports for one declared build: sibling exit-status and stderr accepts recover only their channel checks; observations-recheck recovers nothing; observations-accept recovers the two sibling channel checks and runtime semantics. The native-stdout-accept report is the record because it declares all three target checks unperformed and shares expected_build_id with its evidence.

intent_fidelity.source_intent: Regression-test the C13 boundary: sibling single-channel accepts may recover only their own observations for a shared declared build; recheck reports perform nothing; runtime_observation_semantics is recovered only by one invocation that observed all channels through native-observations-accept.
success_criteria: The built record pins expected_exit_status 0 and the empty stdout and stderr digests, and all five route reports carry the same expected_build_id with accepted/reproduced outcomes.
Recovery A records os_exit_status_observation == recovered, os_stderr_observation == recovered and runtime_observation_semantics == no_evidence.
Recovery B, with only observations-recheck as evidence, reports no_evidence for os_exit_status_observation, os_stderr_observation and runtime_observation_semantics.
Recovery C records os_exit_status_observation == recovered, os_stderr_observation == recovered and runtime_observation_semantics == recovered.

steps.name: Build a native bundle with all three runtime pins
steps.command: {mumei_bin} native-bundle build {root_dir}/scenarios/native_observations_recovery/src/main.mm -o {output_dir}/bundle > {output_dir}/build.log 2>&1 && python3 -c "import hashlib,json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json')); p=r['link_build']; empty=hashlib.sha256(b'').hexdigest(); assert p['expected_exit_status']==0, p; assert p['expected_stdout_sha256']==empty, p; assert p['expected_stderr_sha256']==empty, p; print(hashlib.sha256(open('{output_dir}/bundle/native-bundle.json','rb').read()).hexdigest())" > {output_dir}/build_id.txt; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/build.log; cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt; test $rc -eq 0
steps.artifact_contract: build_id.txt holds sha256(native-bundle.json); link_build pins exit status 0 and the empty stdout/stderr digests; bundle/ holds all five declared members.
steps.verifier_gate: native-bundle build exits 0 and the complete record contains all three runtime observation pins.

steps.name: Accept the exit-status observation
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-exit-status-accept --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_observations_recovery/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/exit_status_report.json > {output_dir}/exit_status.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/exit_status_report.json; cat {output_dir}/exit_status.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/exit_status_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-exit-status-accept-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['acceptance']=='accepted', r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; print('native-exit-status-accept: accepted')"
steps.artifact_contract: exit_status_report.json holds an accepted native-exit-status report for the bundle's expected_build_id.
steps.verifier_gate: native-exit-status-accept exits 0 with acceptance accepted for the declared build.

steps.name: Accept the stdout observation and select the recovery record
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-stdout-accept --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_observations_recovery/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/stdout_report.json > {output_dir}/stdout.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/stdout_report.json; cat {output_dir}/stdout.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/stdout_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-stdout-accept-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['acceptance']=='accepted', r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; assert r['checks_not_performed']==['file_identity', 'freshness', 'os_exit_status_observation', 'os_stderr_observation', 'producer_authenticity', 'runtime_observation_semantics', 'semantic_correspondence'], r; print('native-stdout-accept: selected as the record; three target checks remain unperformed')"
steps.artifact_contract: stdout_report.json is the recovery-eval record: its checks_not_performed declares exit status, stderr and runtime semantics, and expected_build_id binds it to sibling reports for the same bundle.
steps.verifier_gate: native-stdout-accept exits 0 and its declared unperformed set includes all recovery targets.

steps.name: Accept the stderr observation
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-stderr-accept --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_observations_recovery/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/stderr_report.json > {output_dir}/stderr.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/stderr_report.json; cat {output_dir}/stderr.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/stderr_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-stderr-accept-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['acceptance']=='accepted', r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; print('native-stderr-accept: accepted')"
steps.artifact_contract: stderr_report.json holds an accepted native-stderr report for the bundle's expected_build_id.
steps.verifier_gate: native-stderr-accept exits 0 with acceptance accepted for the declared build.

steps.name: Recheck all runtime observations without performing recovery
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-observations-recheck --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_observations_recovery/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/recheck_report.json > {output_dir}/recheck.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/recheck_report.json; cat {output_dir}/recheck.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/recheck_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-observations-recheck-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['observations_recheck']=='reproduced', r; assert r['runtime_observation_schema']=='mumei.runtime-observation/v1', r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; print('native-observations-recheck: reproduced; remains a recovery non-performer')"
steps.artifact_contract: recheck_report.json holds a reproduced runtime-observation recheck report for the same expected_build_id; its schema is not a recovery performer.
steps.verifier_gate: native-observations-recheck exits 0 and emits the runtime-observation schema descriptor.

steps.name: Accept all channels from one invocation
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent native-observations-accept --core {mumei_bin} --bundle {output_dir}/bundle --source {root_dir}/scenarios/native_observations_recovery/src/main.mm --expected-build-id $(cat {output_dir}/build_id.txt) --output {output_dir}/observations_accept_report.json > {output_dir}/observations_accept.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/observations_accept_report.json; cat {output_dir}/observations_accept.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/observations_accept_report.json')); assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.native-observations-accept-report/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['acceptance']=='accepted', r; assert r['expected_build_id']==open('{output_dir}/build_id.txt').read().strip(), r; assert 'runtime_observation_semantics' in r['discharged_checks'], r; print('native-observations-accept: accepted all channels and one-invocation semantics')"
steps.artifact_contract: observations_accept_report.json holds the accepted one-invocation observations report for the same expected_build_id, including runtime_observation_semantics.
steps.verifier_gate: native-observations-accept exits 0 and accepts all three runtime pins from one invocation.

steps.name: Recovery A: sibling channel accepts do not recover runtime semantics
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent recovery-eval --record {output_dir}/stdout_report.json --evidence {output_dir}/exit_status_report.json --evidence {output_dir}/stderr_report.json --output {output_dir}/recovery_a.json > {output_dir}/recovery_a.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/recovery_a.json; cat {output_dir}/recovery_a.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/recovery_a.json')); expected={'file_identity':'no_evidence','freshness':'no_evidence','os_exit_status_observation':'recovered','os_stderr_observation':'recovered','producer_authenticity':'no_evidence','runtime_observation_semantics':'no_evidence','semantic_correspondence':'no_evidence'}; assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.unperformed-check-recovery/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['checks_declared'] is True; assert r['checks']==expected, r['checks']; assert r['recovered']==['os_exit_status_observation','os_stderr_observation'], r['recovered']; assert r['unrecovered']==['file_identity','freshness','producer_authenticity','runtime_observation_semantics','semantic_correspondence'], r['unrecovered']; print('Recovery A:', r['checks'])"
steps.artifact_contract: recovery_a.json reports only the matching exit-status and stderr checks recovered; runtime_observation_semantics remains no_evidence.
steps.verifier_gate: recovery-eval composes the two shared-build channel accepts without composing one-invocation runtime semantics.

steps.name: Recovery B: a reproduced recheck report recovers no runtime checks
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent recovery-eval --record {output_dir}/stdout_report.json --evidence {output_dir}/recheck_report.json --output {output_dir}/recovery_b.json > {output_dir}/recovery_b.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/recovery_b.json; cat {output_dir}/recovery_b.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/recovery_b.json')); expected={'file_identity':'no_evidence','freshness':'no_evidence','os_exit_status_observation':'no_evidence','os_stderr_observation':'no_evidence','producer_authenticity':'no_evidence','runtime_observation_semantics':'no_evidence','semantic_correspondence':'no_evidence'}; assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.unperformed-check-recovery/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['checks_declared'] is True; assert r['checks']==expected, r['checks']; assert r['recovered']==[], r['recovered']; assert r['unrecovered']==['file_identity','freshness','os_exit_status_observation','os_stderr_observation','producer_authenticity','runtime_observation_semantics','semantic_correspondence'], r['unrecovered']; print('Recovery B:', r['checks'])"
steps.artifact_contract: recovery_b.json reports no runtime checks recovered from the observations-recheck report.
steps.verifier_gate: recovery-eval does not treat a reproduced observations-recheck report as a performer.

steps.name: Recovery C: one-invocation acceptance recovers runtime semantics
steps.command: {mumei_agent_python} -m agent recovery-eval --record {output_dir}/stdout_report.json --evidence {output_dir}/observations_accept_report.json --output {output_dir}/recovery_c.json > {output_dir}/recovery_c.log 2>&1; rc=$?; cat {output_dir}/recovery_c.json; cat {output_dir}/recovery_c.log; test $rc -eq 0 && python3 -c "import json; r=json.load(open('{output_dir}/recovery_c.json')); expected={'file_identity':'no_evidence','freshness':'no_evidence','os_exit_status_observation':'recovered','os_stderr_observation':'recovered','producer_authenticity':'no_evidence','runtime_observation_semantics':'recovered','semantic_correspondence':'no_evidence'}; assert r['schema_version']=='mumei.unperformed-check-recovery/v1', r['schema_version']; assert r['checks_declared'] is True; assert r['checks']==expected, r['checks']; assert r['recovered']==['os_exit_status_observation','os_stderr_observation','runtime_observation_semantics'], r['recovered']; assert r['unrecovered']==['file_identity','freshness','producer_authenticity','semantic_correspondence'], r['unrecovered']; print('Recovery C:', r['checks'])"
steps.artifact_contract: recovery_c.json reports exit status, stderr and runtime_observation_semantics recovered through the accepted one-invocation observations report.
steps.verifier_gate: recovery-eval recovers the two sibling channel checks and runtime semantics from native-observations-accept.

intro: Step 1: build a zero-output native program and pin exit status plus both stream digests.
Steps 2–6: produce three sibling channel accepts, a reproduced observations recheck, and an accepted one-invocation observations report for the same build ID.
Step 7: sibling exit-status and stderr accepts recover their own channel checks, but runtime_observation_semantics stays no_evidence.
Step 8: observations-recheck is not a recovery performer, even when reproduced.
Step 9: only observations-accept recovers runtime_observation_semantics alongside the two sibling channel checks.
narrative.before: A mistaken recovery fold might compose one-invocation semantics from separate channel reports or infer it from a successful recheck.
narrative.after: Only the accepted observations route, which observes all channels in one invocation, performs runtime_observation_semantics.
